hero.pitch: Odoo ERP Specialist and Python Developer at Core 48 (Pvt) Ltd, Sri Lanka. I deliver end-to-end ERP implementations that turn complex business processes into streamlined, scalable systems.

story: I joined Core 48 (Pvt) Ltd as a Software Engineer Intern in May 2025 and was promoted to Associate Software Engineer within six months — a reflection of the responsibility I took on from day one.

Since then, I've led and contributed to three real-world Odoo ERP implementations across the garment manufacturing, higher education, and industrial sectors. My work spans the full delivery lifecycle: requirement gathering, module configuration, Python and XML customisation, UAT, end-user training, and post-implementation support.
Alongside my professional work, I am studying for my BSc (Hons) in Information Technology at SLIIT, keeping my foundations strong while applying them in production environments every day.
